titre: Two pieces hit your queen. Take, or run? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Take his queen, or run? 👇 Only 1.Nd7+! wins: the knight forks king and queen, 1...Kc8 2.Nxb6+. 1.Qxb6 cxb6 is just a trade (Stockfish 16, composed position). One new puzzle every day.
